name: A request with an end date before the start date is rejected

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.daycalc@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Select 'Annual Leave' as leave type, set Start date to 2026-11-25 and End date to 2026-11-20, and enter reason 'E2E badrange marker'.
An inline validation error is shown telling the user the end date must be on or after the start date, and no request is created (the form is still displayed).
